title: Absolute Galois fixed field of a subgroup
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is Galois: separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal (for every $\beta\in K$ the minimal polynomial of $\beta$ over $k$ is a product of polynomials of degree one in $K[T]$). Let $L$ be an intermediate field, $k\subseteq L\subseteq K$, and let $H\subseteq\operatorname{Gal}(K/k)$ be the subgroup of $k$-algebra automorphisms of $K$ fixing $L$ pointwise. Then the fixed field of $H$ is $L$: an element $y\in K$ satisfies $h(y)=y$ for all $h\in H$ if and only if $y\in L$.
